source_areas.description: TypeScript JSON-RPC plugin process, public types, loopback UI server, compiled output, and protocol-focused tests.
Browser iframe bridge, theme-message handling, CSS design tokens, utility classes, and runtime token helpers.
Slack, form and approval, and image-crop reference plugins with manifests, TypeScript handlers, browser UIs, builds, and tests.
Workspace orchestration, Python process interoperability tests, contribution rules, and continuous validation and publication workflows.

feature_surfaces.title: JSON-RPC plugin runtime
feature_surfaces.description: Registers headless and interactive handlers and dispatches handshake, invoke, ping, shutdown, result, error, and notification messages over stdio.

feature_surfaces.title: Interactive UI server
feature_surfaces.description: Serves confined plugin UI files on loopback, injects bridge and theme assets, and resolves capability-bound submit or cancel callbacks.

feature_surfaces.title: Iframe UI bridge
feature_surfaces.description: Exposes props, submission, cancellation, and theme updates through loopback callbacks or parent-window messaging with source and optional origin checks.

feature_surfaces.title: Plugin UI tokens
feature_surfaces.description: Publishes Flyto2 CSS variables, utility classes, and JavaScript helpers for applying and reading host theme overrides.

feature_surfaces.title: Plugin manifest contract
feature_surfaces.description: Defines plugin identity, runtime compatibility, step schemas, connection rules, UI presentation, and required secret names in YAML.

feature_surfaces.title: Slack reference plugin
feature_surfaces.description: Demonstrates context-secret resolution, external message creation, and public-channel discovery through the Slack Web API.

feature_surfaces.title: Form and approval plugin
feature_surfaces.description: Collects dynamic structured input or an approval decision through local modal interfaces with explicit cancellation behavior.

feature_surfaces.title: Image crop plugin
feature_surfaces.description: Provides an interactive browser crop workflow that returns encoded image data, crop geometry, and original dimensions.

feature_surfaces.title: Test and publish automation
feature_surfaces.description: Builds and tests all workspaces, exercises process interoperability, runs security gates, and publishes tagged public packages with provenance.
